_comment: WP29 shared cases. The backend (src/utils/cancellationLabelPolicy.js) and the frontend (lib/cancellation-policy.ts, guard scripts/cancellation-policy-check.mts, which keeps a copy in scripts/fixtures) both run these, so the wording a couple reads cannot drift. Expected strings are written by hand, not generated.

ladder.name: platform default (35 / 15 / 7)
ladder.text: 50% back 35 or more days before the event; 25% back 15 to 34 days before the event; nothing back 14 days or fewer before the event

ladder.name: four bands, full refund first, order of slabs does not matter
ladder.text: full refund 30 or more days before the event; 60% back 14 to 29 days before the event; 30% back 7 to 13 days before the event; nothing back 6 days or fewer before the event

ladder.name: adjacent day bands read as one day, singular
ladder.text: 90% back 3 or more days before the event; 50% back 2 days before the event; nothing back 1 day or fewer before the event

summary.name: Non-Refundable by label, no stored row
summary.headline: Non-Refundable
summary.detail: If you cancel, the venue keeps everything you have paid toward the booking. Money that is not the venue's to keep still comes back to you: any overpayment beyond the agreed price, your refundable security deposit, and everything you paid if the venue cancels or force majeure applies.

summary.name: Non-Refundable with its own stored row
summary.headline: Non-Refundable
summary.detail: If you cancel, the venue keeps everything you have paid toward the booking. Money that is not the venue's to keep still comes back to you: any overpayment beyond the agreed price, your refundable security deposit, and everything you paid if the venue cancels or force majeure applies.

summary.name: Refundable = the platform schedule
summary.headline: Refundable
summary.detail: Refunds follow Wedding Wala's standard schedule: 50% back 35 or more days before the event; 25% back 15 to 34 days before the event; nothing back 14 days or fewer before the event.

summary.name: bare Partially Refundable label with no stored detail
summary.headline: Partially Refundable
summary.detail: Refunds follow Wedding Wala's standard schedule: 50% back 35 or more days before the event; 25% back 15 to 34 days before the event; nothing back 14 days or fewer before the event.

summary.name: no label, platform schedule
summary.headline: Standard refund schedule
summary.detail: Refunds follow Wedding Wala's standard schedule: full refund 30 or more days before the event; 50% back 14 to 29 days before the event; 25% back 7 to 13 days before the event; nothing back 6 days or fewer before the event.

summary.name: Partially Refundable, venue keeps 40%
summary.headline: Partially Refundable: venue keeps 40%
summary.detail: If you cancel, the venue keeps 40% of what you have paid toward the booking and you get the rest back.

summary.name: Partially Refundable, venue keeps PKR 20,000
summary.headline: Partially Refundable: venue keeps PKR 20,000
summary.detail: If you cancel, the venue keeps PKR 20,000 of what you have paid toward the booking and you get back anything above it.

summary.name: a preset ladder saved later, the label was Non-Refundable
summary.headline: Refund schedule
summary.detail: Full refund 30 or more days before the event; 50% back 14 to 29 days before the event; nothing back 13 days or fewer before the event.
